column1: # Per-class and TOTAL ceilings on the §11.4.261 finding count. Every sweep
# run compares the live count against these numbers; a class that RISES
# above its ceiling makes the sweep and CM-ZERO-FINDINGS-MONOTONE-RATCHET
# refuse the seam. A ceiling may only ever be LOWERED, after a real fix.
# These are MEASURED counts from a real sweep, not a seeded zero. A ratchet
# whose first row is a lie is worse than no ratchet at all.
